name: next_eq_getElem
statement: List α} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ l) : l.next a ha = l[(l.idxOf a + 1) % l.length]'(Nat.mod_lt _ <| by grind)

name: prev_eq_getElem
statement: List α} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ l) (ha₀ : a ≠ l.head (ne_nil_of_mem ha)) : l.prev a ha = l[l.idxOf a - 1]?

name: prev_infix_of_mem_tail
statement: List α} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ l) (ha₀ : a ≠ l.head (ne_nil_of_mem ha)) : [l.prev a ha, a] <:+: l

name: prev_reverse_eq_next
statement: List α) (h : Nodup l) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ l) : prev l.reverse x (mem_reverse.mpr hx) = next l x hx
